My experience has been profoundly disappointing due to the pervasive unprofessionalism exhibited by both the clinical and administrative staff. From the GP to the receptionists, the level of organisation and patient care is alarmingly inadequate.

We were initially accepted as patients under the assumption that we fell within their designated postcode radius, only to receive an abrupt and unanticipated call stating that we were being removed. It appears that patient acceptance is dictated more by arbitrary factors, such as staffing shortages or previous patient attrition, rather than any genuine commitment to providing consistent care.

The cumulative experience reflects a troubling lack of professionalism, courtesy, and regard for patient welfare. I urge prospective patients to exercise extreme caution. Reviews from other patients corroborate this pattern of mismanagement and inadequate care.

This practice fails to meet the fundamental standards expected of a medical service provider. Avoid registering here if you value competent and reliable healthcare.
